0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, while GG Jackson, Jerami Grant and Micah Peavy are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions (Jackson and Peavy with ankle issues, Grant with undisclosed soreness). Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, and Blake Hinson, Kyle Filipowski and Trey Alexander are day-to-day and game-time decisions (Hinson with a hamstring issue, Filipowski with a back issue, Alexander with a knee issue), and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with Utah winning the last meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Grizzlies a 45% chance to win.
